expectations.text: Three distinct state types model draft, running, finished
expectations.evidence: Draft { config }, Running { config, handle }, Finished { output }.

expectations.text: output accessor exists only on the finished state
submit() exists only on the draft state
expectations.evidence: submit() in impl Job<Draft>, takes self by value.

expectations.text: Transition methods take self by value
expectations.evidence: submit consumes the draft; commented negative cases show re-submit of moved draft is rejected.

expectations.text: State-specific data lives inside the state type, not Option+unreachable
expectations.evidence: handle and output are plain fields; 0 Option fields; explicitly avoids the Option+unreachable anti-pattern.

expectations.text: No unwrap/expect/unreachable/panic; fallible transitions return Result
expectations.evidence: No panic paths; compiles clean under edition 2024. (Result-on-join-failure less explicitly modeled than the with-skill run, but no panic present.)
